cli.usage: Unknown option '--bogus'. Fix: Run `seampact help` for the commands and their options.
Usage: seampact <command> [options]

Commands:
  init [--blank] [--editor-schemas[=ignore|commit|none]] [--no-modelines] [--no-ignore-files]
                                           Write a new project here: seampact.config.yaml and contract/api.yaml, a small example (--blank: the api header alone), with its modeline and editor schemas, git-ignored by default.
  init --modelines [--config <path>] [--editor-schemas[=ignore|commit|none]] [--no-ignore-files]
                                           Write or correct the modeline of every contract file of the app config's `path` sources, and their editor schemas.
  compile [--config <path>] [--out <dir>] [--editor-schemas]
                                           Compile the contract sources the app config's targets use; --editor-schemas writes each contract's editor schemas, which check declared names (to workspace.editorSchemas, .seampact/schemas by default).
  generate [--config <path>] [--force] [--app-directory <dir> [--config-name <label>]] [--bundle-directory <source>=<dir>]
                                           Generate every target entry of the app config, or of every app a root config lists; --force overwrites, or removes when stale, a generated file edited by hand. A build plugin passes --app-directory (the --config text read as that directory's app config, named --config-name in problems) and --bundle-directory (a bundle it already fetched, checked against the source's integrity, never fetched).
  check [--config <path>] [--app-directory <dir> [--config-name <label>]] [--bundle-directory <source>=<dir>]
                                           Fail when the committed generated files or documents differ from a fresh run; --app-directory, --config-name and --bundle-directory as for generate.
  lint [--config <path>]                   Run the core lint rules over each contract source.
  diff --against <path> [--config <path>]  Classify the changes since the IRs at <path> (an IR file, or a directory of <api>.ir.json that "compile --out <dir>" writes).
  explain <api>.<operationId> [--config <path>]  Print one operation whole, each line commented with the derivation and the file and line it comes from; the api may be left out when the sources hold one.
  bundle (--out <dir> | --tarball <file> | --npm-package <dir>) [--source <name>] [--name <name>] [--version <version>] [--config <path>]
                                           Write the bundle of a `path` source (the config's only one, or --source) and print its integrity; the contract name and version default to the workspace's package.json.
